item.title: Thursday 1 PM Update, Nov 12
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

The Wednesday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for Veterans Day, November 11, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; President Trump at Arlington says the U.S. has won the Iran war but wants total victory, as the Kennedy family joins the fight over his planned arch; Iran's parliament speaker says Hormuz will not return to its pre-war state; the Nasdaq extends its rally at midday as CoreWeave soars and mortgage rates dip; OpenAI's quarterly revenue reaches ten billion dollars; Gemini arrives on Apple CarPlay; hackers exploit Barracuda and Cisco BroadWorks flaws, one with help from an A I tool; your X feed; Democrats line up to replace New Hampshire's secretary of state and a senator targets kratom; and an eighty-four-year-old pianist keeps a promise.
